name: Shopify
description: Read-only Shopify Admin REST access on one store: shop profile, products, orders and customers

tools.name: get_shop
tools.description: Get the connected Shopify store's own profile (name, primary domain, plan, currency, timezone)

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List Shopify products, optionally filtered by publication status

status.description: Optional product status to filter by

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: List Shopify orders of any status (open, closed and cancelled), most recent first

financial_status.description: Optional payment status to filter by

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description: List Shopify customers, most recently created first

needs_review: base_url is "https://{{shop_domain}}", NOT "https://{{shop_domain}}.myshopify.com". The brief asked for the suffixed form, but the vault credential field is a FULL hostname: the registry entry (services/auth/config/integrationTypeRegistry.js, key 'shopify') labels shop_domain with placeholder 'your-store.myshopify.com' and its live-tested testEndpoint is `https://${creds.shop_domain}/admin/api/...`. Appending .myshopify.com in the template would render 'your-store.myshopify.com.myshopify.com' for every credential already stored, breaking every call. If the field is ever redefined as a bare slug, the template must change with it, in the same commit as the registry.

base_url._probe substitutes shop_domain = 'security-incidents-dont-delete-me.myshopify.com' so the blind harness has a store that exists. Chosen because it is Shopify's OWN parked instance, not a merchant's: demo.myshopify.com answers 301 with location https://security-incidents-dont-delete-me.myshopify.com/. Verified by curl 2026-09-12: a non-existent store (quickstart-1a2b3c4d.myshopify.com) answers 404 {"errors":"Not Found"} because *.myshopify.com is wildcard DNS, while this host answers 401 {"errors":"[API] Invalid API key or access token ..."}. Read-only, dummy credential, and the runtime ignores _probe.

API version pinned to 2025-01, not the 2024-10 the brief named: 2025-01 is the version the live-tested registry entry uses, so it is the only Shopify version anything in this repo has exercised. UNVERIFIED which versions Shopify currently supports; 2024-10, 2025-01, 2025-10 and 2026-07 all answered byte-identical 401s at the auth wall on 2026-09-12, so the blind shape-proof CANNOT distinguish a supported pin from an unsupported one. A version pin needs an owner refresh policy; the proof below does not cover it.
Category set to 'commerce_finance' to match the shipped taxonomy (stripe, square, paddle); the scaffolded 'ecommerce' is not a bucket any shipped spec uses.

Payload field names come from the Admin REST documentation (tools_source), not from a live 2xx: no Shopify store was held for this draft. list_customers deliberately does not pick orders_count or total_spent, whose availability varies across Admin API versions.
